name: FirePlus-LHD Digital Interface Unit
summary: Allows the accurate and immediate location of a fire or overheat along the length of our Context Plus Linear Heat Detection cable.
description: Simultaneously monitor up to two zones for fault or fire. The two zones can operate independently from each other or in Interlock/Coincidence detection mode requiring both LHD cables to trigger before transmitting an alarm.
features: Pinpoint the exact location of an incident and respond immediately.
Volt-free outputs for fault and fire alarm, corresponding to each zone.
Connects to our Context Plus conventional and addressable fire alarm control panels. Can also be connected to an industrial process control system using the two-wire RS485 Modbus RTU output.
